description: SHOW COLUMNS' relation-kind keyword is NOT a filter - bare, TABLE and VIEW spellings each resolve tables, views and materialized views alike; the keyword decides only whether a full path is demanded (VIEW always, whatever the object) and the noun in the missing-object refusal (name echoed as written, not expanded); the unnamed listing walks every relation. Plus the CONTAINER scopes: SCHEMA lists everything it holds and demands the full path BEFORE existence, DATABASE spans its schemas, ACCOUNT takes no name; container totals asserted as at-least-mine where the account may hold more. All live-verified. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ShowColumnsRelationKindTest and ShowColumnsScopeTest (both now retired).
